source: 外研社版必修第三册 Unit 6 同主题完形(洪灾志愿者/家庭应急计划/救援犬/暴风雪困村/山火后重建/海啸演练)。用词限 U6/初中/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读听力关不撞。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: A Day as a Flood Volunteer
passages.text: Last summer, heavy rain caused a terrible (1)____ in our town, and the river rose over its banks. I decided to (2)____ as a volunteer to help my neighbours. Many families had lost their homes and had (5)____ to go, so we gave them food and a dry place to (6)____. One old man kept thanking us, even though he had lost almost everything he (7)____. Helping others made me feel that even a small action could bring people (8)____. By the end of the week, the water had begun to (9)____, and people slowly returned to clean their houses. had nowhere to go 无处可去。
a dry place to stay 待的干燥地方。
everything he owned 他拥有的一切。
bring people hope 给人希望。
the water began to fall 水开始退去。

passages.title: Our Family Emergency Plan
passages.text: After watching the news about a big (1)____, my family decided to make an emergency plan. questions.explanation: news about a big disaster 关于大灾难的新闻。
extra food 额外的食物。
keep some medicine 备些药品。
a safe place to meet 安全的会合地点。
call for help 呼救。
turn off ... immediately 立刻关掉。
a bit afraid at first 起初有点害怕。
helped her feel safer 让她感到更安全。
a storm is coming 风暴将至。

passages.title: Max the Rescue Dog
passages.text: Max is not an ordinary dog; he is a trained (1)____ dog who works with a mountain team. The rescue team could find (6)____ at first, and they were slowly losing hope. Then Max suddenly began to (7)____ at one spot and dug quickly with his paws. questions.explanation: a rescue dog 救援犬。
an avalanche rushes down 雪崩冲下。
every minute counts 每分钟都很关键。
a thick layer of snow 厚厚一层雪。
after a heavy blizzard 一场大暴风雪后。
could find nobody 一个人也找不到。
began to bark 开始吠叫。
cold but still alive 寒冷但仍活着。

passages.title: Trapped by a Blizzard
passages.text: One December, an exceptionally heavy (1)____ hit our small mountain village without much warning. Within hours, the snow was so deep that the only road out was completely (2)____. We were trapped, and the electricity soon went (3)____ as well. My grandmother stayed calm and told us not to (4)____. On the third day, we heard the sound of a (7)____ flying low above the village. The pilot had spotted our smoke and dropped boxes of food and (8)____ down to us. Everyone cheered and waved. questions.explanation: a heavy blizzard hit 一场大暴风雪袭来。

the electricity went off 停电了。

passages.title: Rebuilding After the Fire
passages.text: Two years ago, a terrible (1)____ swept through the forest near our town and burned hundreds of homes. When the fire was finally (2)____, many families had lost everything they owned. Little by little, new walls and roofs began to (8)____ where the burned houses had stood. A year later, our street looked almost (9)____ again. The fire had taken so much from us, yet it also showed us how (10)____ people can be when they work together.

passages.title: A Tsunami Drill That Worked
passages.text: Our seaside town lies close to the ocean, so we know that a (1)____ is always a possible danger. questions.explanation: close to the ocean, a tsunami is a danger 海啸是危险。
